summaryZh: Gilson Lab 评估和改进计算机辅助药物设计方法，并开展药物发现及分子马达等非平衡系统研究。方法结合理论、计算、信息学和实验。
topics: 分子马达与非平衡系统

evidence.quote: We use theoretical, computational, informatic, and experimental approaches to evaluate and advance the methods of computer-aided drug design. We also work on drug discovery projects and study molecular motors and other nonequilibrium systems.
